R4, R6 (ratify): a multi-part bundle — its bundle.md, a data file and a registered capture — crosses whole: every part is copied to the published store under its own sha, and each copy hashes to that sha
R6 (ratify): a bundle in no case publishes exactly its own parts at edition 1 — no container is assembled or named, and the answer names no case
R4, R6 (ratify): the answer's gateVersion is the catalogue's stamp — `plane-gate/1.0 (bio-checks <CATALOG_VERSION>)`, never the gate's own name alone — and it is the one the commit records

R4 (ratify): before anything publishes — no signature is MALFORMED, an absent bundle ABSENT, a stale sha RATIFY_STALE, an unregistered key SIG_UNKNOWN_KEY, a signature over another statement SIG_BAD_SIGNATURE; none publishes, and the right signature then does

R5, R6, R10 (ratify): re-ratifying the same sha converges — existed, nothing re-copied; a newer revision ratifies as the next edition and the published bytes of the older one stay published, unchanged
R4 (ratify): the gate refuses a broken image — a reference to a bundle that does not exist — naming exactly its check (C-6.2), and nothing publishes
R4, R19 (ratify): a revoked key cannot ratify — NO_SIGNERS when it was the only one, SIG_UNKNOWN_KEY beside another active key — and nothing publishes; reactivated, it ratifies

R4, R12 (ratify): the operator's bearer token carrying a member's VALID signature is refused C-32.14 naming its class, and publishes nothing; the member's own session carrying it crosses, and the record names the key's member as signer

R3, R5, R12, R13 (deliverer, legacy): the store's committers called as a plane before REC-128 called them — a signer and no deliverer — commit the deliverer null, never the signer

R57: caseFileWake is now while an edition is due, else the ledger's earliest next try, else null; with no reach to the published bucket from here it is null; the sweep never throws

tests: R57: the sweep takes the oldest owed editions, two a tick (a third waits), and builds each; a second tick builds the third; a tick after that calls the assembly 0 times
R57: a failed assembly is recorded with its code by the assembly and retried only when the ledger says it is due; the sweep hands the assembly the edition's state with its publishing group

R39, R57: the sweep copies the materials first — one the evidence store holds is copied to the published bucket before the assembly, one it lacks keeps the edition failed MATERIAL_MISSING (the assembly told which) and is copied once it is there; the next tick builds

R57: the sweep never records stopped itself — a material the evidence store ANSWERS absent is told to the assembly (prior.absent true, each item {sha, absent}), and the ledger's writer holds the count and the stop; a copy that failed is not an absence (prior.absent false)

R57: the tick is bounded — it takes no further edition once it has pulled the files or the bytes constant; the constants are the named ones; no stop or size constant here (publication's writer and public-read's assembly own those)
R57: caseFileWake is now while an edition is due, else the ledger's earliest next try, else null; with no reach to the published bucket from here it is null; the sweep never throws

R57 C4: a record row whose text does not hash to the part is never put

R57 C6: a world whose record provides no textAtSha (the dependency absent) heals nothing, asks the bucket nothing, and the assembly states FINDING_MISSING as today

R57 (f): bounds — a 450-finding edition with every bundle.md absent is healed over ticks of at most 400 puts each, not assembled until complete, built once
R57 (f) control: two small editions are both taken in one tick (two a tick)

tests: R20: an absent, blank or machine author is MACHINE_CANNOT_RELEASE (C-32.1) before anything else is read
R20: an empty acknowledgment is NO_ACKNOWLEDGMENT (C-33.10), then an empty mitigation NO_MITIGATION (C-33.11), each trimmed; nothing moves

R20: an acknowledgment, then a mitigation, over RELEASE_ACK_MAX or holding a quote, a backslash, a CR or a newline is BAD_ACKNOWLEDGMENT or BAD_MITIGATION, naming the bound and the characters; the bound itself passes
R21: the selection's refusal is answered as retrieval's refuse-weight resolve gives it: NO_SUCH_SELECTION, SELECTION_NOT_YOURS
R21, R27 (refuse-gate, K674 (4)): a query selection whose answer swapped at a constant count is refused SET_MOVED and moves nothing; a fresh selection over the same criterion releases

R22, R27: a member is crucial when the record's criticality or the document's own says so; neither rides a batch
R22: a member no longer held is NOT_INFORMATION; each class's offenders are sorted
R23: a member's `missing` names, in order, a malformed content_hash, data/dataset.json, a file in snapshots/, and each register document without a provenance_chain (C-18.9)

R25: a member whose bundle.md is gone at its turn is NO_DOCUMENT, one whose state_history cannot be extended UNSPLICEABLE_STATE_HISTORY, and a refusal from promote is answered as promote gave it; each names bundleId and releasedSoFar, and the members already released stay released
R20, R26: the store half's `release` op reads the handle, the account and the control plane's stamps from the query

R51: release reads its handle, acknowledgment and mitigation from the body, else the query: a body carrying them answers as the same fields in the query do, never NO_ACKNOWLEDGMENT or NO_MITIGATION; a body carrying author, viewer or owner changes no stamp
R15: no place is named in the release's answers

tests: R40: op=publishat answers C-32.13 and C-32.15 before the payload is read and MALFORMED (an absent at included), byte-identical to op=caseratify

R40: every refusal op=caseratify answers before its commit is op=publishat's, byte for byte and in R2's order (C-53.12, C-92.10, C-92.11, CASE_RATIFY_STALE, NO_SIGNERS, SIG_<reason>, GATE_REFUSED), each writing nothing

R40, R32: past every refusal op=publishat hands publish-schedule R1 the signature, the signer read from it, the deliverer from the session, at, checked and by, and relays its answer as given, its refusals unchanged; R32's arm reads the body

R40, R3: R3's refusals before its commit are op=publishat's (MALFORMED, CASE_UNSIGNED, NO_CASE_DOCUMENT, CASE_RATIFY_STALE, caseAuthority's, CASE_EDITION_ALREADY_RATIFIED, C-65.1, CASE_PRODUCTION_DIVERGED), each writing nothing
R40: a refusal publication's commit would answer now (here CASE_FORMAT_SUPERSEDED and SOURCE_CONSENT_WITHDRAWN) is op=publishat's, the commit's own answer, and nothing is written
R40, R45, R46: with no hold reader registered R41's holds cannot be read, so op=publishat answers SCHEDULE_UNCHECKABLE (C-58.6) naming it, nothing written, and op=caseratify is unchanged
R40, R41: a read R41 makes that fails or answers nothing (a hold read answering null, a money fact unread) is SCHEDULE_UNCHECKABLE naming each, never a clear reading

R41: checked records, each part in canonical JSON with its lists ordered, the sources with their standing, each signer's declared ties to what the document names (its people, its member ties, its money facts' parties), the holds and every stamp, and the key's fingerprint; it names no author or source the document does not

R42, R48: at its time, with nothing changed, the publisher commits as R3 commits and answers published with the commit's instant; R3's discharge, R36's telling and R37's sealed weeks follow, and the steps the Worker holds are named not done
R42, R46: a source, a signer's tie or a hold that changed since signing stops it, one entry per cause naming what changed (C-58.7, C-58.8, C-58.9), nothing committed

R42, R46: a check signing passed that refuses at the time (the conclusion moved, a signer no longer active, the signature not over these bytes) stops it as SCHEDULED_CHECK_REFUSED (C-58.10) with the refusal as its cause; nothing committed
R42, R45: what cannot be read at the time stops it (UNREADABLE naming what), and so does an exception inside it: it never throws and never passes
R43: at start this module creates publish-schedule and registers R42 once with its registerScheduledPublisher (N823), and the registered publisher is R42

R3: an edition publish-schedule holds waiting is refused PUBLISH_AT_ALREADY_SET naming its set time, nothing written; the same signature and at again through op=publishat answer publish-schedule R1's own answer
R44: the pre-flight answers publish_at — offered with the group's zone when the active profiles hold one, else not offered, PUBLISH_AT_NO_ZONE — and its other answers are unchanged

R44 (T50, N1203): the offered zone is the one retrieval R69 reads — a local correction governs; no zone there offers nothing, even with a profile zone; a retrieval that cannot be read falls back to the profiles
R45: the hold reader is registered once; a second is refused HOLD_READER_DECLARED, and the first stays the one read
R48: op=publishat never commits; only R42 does, after its checks pass again and nothing changed
R6, R39 (with R42): a retry of the same signature on an edition committed without the Worker copies its materials and assembles its container
R32, R40: ratificationOp routes publishat; any other op is not this module's

R42, R39: at its time, with the bucket reachable, the publisher copies each evidence-held and derived material after the commit, a derived one never from captures/, and a missing one never changes the answer

R52 (control): one bad signature in the sitting commits nothing — a stranger's key, or another registered member's (not the case's signer), is that member's SIG_ refusal naming it, asked before anything is written; the sitting with the right signature commits

R52 (control): a member refused by R4's checks — a stale sha (RATIFY_STALE), a project's own document (C-58.1), a bundle the session cannot see (answered as never minted) — is answered with the act's own refusal naming the member, and nothing is written
R52 (control): a member's commit refused after the case's (evidence nothing ratified rests on, C-58.3) rolls the case back with it: the refusal names the member and nothing is written
R52: members of any other shape are MALFORMED before anything is read; absent or empty members sign the case alone, as before
